topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and frames the lecture as an exploration of the mechanisms coordinating the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition via PAMPs, DAMPs, and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: The innate immune system detects infection and cellular injury through specialized pattern recognition receptors that sense conserved molecular patterns and initiate intracellular inflammatory signaling cascades.

topics.label: Inflammatory mediator signaling, cell recruitment, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: Activated sentinel cells orchestrate the acute inflammatory response by coordinating leukocyte extravasation into tissues, lymphatic cell trafficking, and potential systemic complications such as septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: Tissues conclude inflammatory responses through passive and active shutdown mechanisms, coordinate wound healing, and adapt to persistent stimuli through chronic inflammation and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of the next topic
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the topic of the upcoming lecture.
